title: What are the different names Allah [swt] gives to the Qur'an
excerpt: Imam Suyuti has listed 55 names of the Qur'an given by the Qur'an itself. Amongst them are:Al-Qur'an [that which is recited]Al-Kitab [written down]Kareem [most noble]KalamAllah [speech of Allah]Nur [ light in amidst a world of darkness]Huda [guidance...
